images.title: Twelve curtain strips and their two piles
images.purpose: Show multiplying a length: 12 strips of 2 m 40 cm, the metres sorted into one pile (24 m) and the centimetres into another (480 cm = 4 m 80 cm), and the total 28 m 80 cm.
images.composition: Twelve strips in a grid on the left, two piles on the right and the total at the bottom.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. STRIPS: exactly 12 identical strips in a grid of 6 columns and 2 rows at the left (x 100 to 800, y 150 to 300); each strip is a rectangle 100 px wide and 60 px high, made of a teal #0072B2 part 84 px wide (the 2 m) and an amber #E69F00 part 16 px wide (the 40 cm), the columns 20 px apart and the rows 30 px apart. Above the grid the label 12 strips of 2 m 40 cm in 40 px bold at x 460, y 110. PILES: at the right two boxes, a teal box 460 by 120 px (x 900 to 1360, y 150 to 270) with the text 12 × 2 m = 24 m in white 44 px, and an amber box 460 by 120 px (x 900 to 1360, y 310 to 430) with the text 12 × 40 cm = 480 cm = 4 m 80 cm in dark 40 px. TOTAL: one reddish purple #CC79A7 rounded box 900 by 110 px (x 278 to 1178, y 560 to 670) with the text 24 m + 4 m 80 cm = 28 m 80 cm in 56 px bold; a thin grey #6B7280 arrow from each pile down to this box. In all: 12 strips, 2 piles, 1 total box. All shapes are flat fills with thin dark #2B2B2B outlines (3 px), no shadows and no gradients; all text is dark #1F2937 sans-serif. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: Multiply the m and the cm separately, then change the cm to m and add.
images.description: Twelve curtain strips of 2 m 40 cm with the metres and the centimetres sorted into two piles and the total 28 m 80 cm.
images.context: Concept image for Multiplying a Length. It follows the idea of the shirts for 20 children in your maths book (break the length into m and cm and multiply) and shows the concept's own example, 12 curtains of 2 m 40 cm (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Count the 12 strips with the child. The slip to watch: leaving the 40 cm as it is and writing 24 m 40 cm.
